question_stem: A dolphin is swimming under water at a constant speed of 4.50 m s^{-1}.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text:
The dolphin emits a sound as it swims directly towards a stationary submerged diver. The
frequency of the sound heard by the diver is 9560 Hz. The speed of sound in the water is
1510 m s^{-1}.
Determine the frequency, to three significant figures, of the sound emitted by the dolphin.
frequency = Hz
